testProvenance.ordinaryFlows: Stable public planner/pilot supplies ordinary held keyboard inputs to original model. Three real sequences place a pipe, remove that exact ID, restore it with B, form a ready but unsubmitted loop, focus PUMP and win with unused stock. Recorded times in raw flows are model-simulation times, not browser recording durations.
testProvenance.ordinaryRejections: Public-only cycle search plus ordinary A/B/focus inputs covers all7 diagnostic causes. The three topology-only double loops have all local conditions met but two active components, and actual PUMP presses reject them without altering the drawing. No author witness or production solver is read.
testProvenance.publicClueFixture: One clearly named fixture changes only public R1 clue from1 to0 on a fresh original state. Two ordinary E3 edits then recompute facts. The fixture compares actual0/0 satisfaction with unchanged clue:null/COUNT0. It is not one of the authored puzzles, a normal victory or a recorded gameplay sequence.
testProvenance.runtimeLayouts: Two original runtime sequences use Enter, Space and P for real menu/play/place/pause at960/1280. Twenty snapshots per viewport explicitly replace scratch-served create with a public-state copy and step with no-op. Those40 are layout-only;38 derive from authored input states and2 from the labelled clue fixture. They do not restore a simulation or earn browser wins.
testProvenance.readOnly: Each state is deeply frozen and unchanged after actual rendering. Throwing getters guard all underscore internals, hypothetical hidden solution fields and truth fields on vertices/edges/plots; any PureModel API access also throws. External time/raw-input changes preserve commands, HUD and result.
testProvenance.history: Initial preliminary a973 evidence remains incomplete and retained. Three spacing/copy corrections plus terminal pump subtitle produced633da51; its full53/2/40 run passed and remains historical. Root then approved two PUMP wording clarifications. This v2 report fully reruns all53/2/40 on05ed55, so no old generation is relabeled or substituted. Model/formal/pilot/math matrices were not repeated for these text-only changes.

confirmedWording: Required trees, forbidden flowers and optional neutral junctions have distinct original shapes and textual legend; every vertex shows its actual ID and degree.
Each placed pipe occupies exactly the public unit-edge midpoint, endpoint length and orientation. Dashed empty edges never consume or depict a physical pipe.
Every physical P1-P16 remains in exactly one current stock or edge location; selected pipe IDs and sixteen inventory labels stay explicit.
An unhinted region is neutral NO CLUE with a horizontal dash and separate actual COUNT. Numeric zero is a constrained green0/0 only when satisfied, verified in the one labelled public-clue fixture.
Only numeric matched plots receive a green underline. Their counts are read directly from the model, with no inferred private solution.
Connected trees are not declared watered before acceptance. Blue pipe interiors appear only after phase won and follow every actual selected edge.
All three real two-loop counterexamples satisfy degree2, tree, flower and numeric-clue conditions but fail ONE LOOP, remain dry and receive multiple-loops rejection.
The three ordinary trial-place, actual-remove and B-undo flows restore the same pipe ID and all derived graph facts without refunding time or edit counters.
Stock exhaustion cannot add a phantom pipe. Removal at exhausted stock and undo of that removal remain visible and exact.
Goal readiness alone does not win. A edits an edge until PUMP has focus; only the focused pump displays A START. The pump subtitle says ALL CHECKS REQUIRED, including flower avoidance.
Every rejection reason and timeout has short cause-specific result text. Won/lost canvas labels remove active start instructions.
Top-row tree canopy clears the title strip. Bottom vertex IDs end at456, role legend begins463 and ends476, before footer479.
Both full viewport layouts retain all sidebar text, one-line A help, short tips and readable glass dialogs. No physical hardware, APK or video result is claimed.

findings: Soft orchard ground, terracotta unit pipes, fruit trees, crossed flower markers and stone junctions are distinct and readable. The top canopy and bottom role legend no longer overlap text.

Numbers and physical IDs follow the exact public drawing. The selected-edge action remains separate from the independent PUMP focus; stock exhaustion offers removal rather than a phantom reserved pipe.
The0/0 fixture receives a numeric match indication while the unhinted region keeps its dash, neutral NO CLUE and separate actual count.
The two-loop drawing remains dry with ONE LOOP failing although its other checks pass. Goal-ready still asks for explicit PUMP focus and submission.
Only accepted wins show blue water along the actual loop. Short terminal reasons and full glass-dialog/sidebar layouts fit both viewport sizes.
The512px icon depicts a decorative tree and closed irrigation loop; it is self-contained original vector art and does not disclose any board solution.
